capabilities: Full-text search Claude Code and Codex session transcripts with filters by agent, project, topic and date
Monitor running agent sessions as live cards and answer prompts, plans and questions from Obsidian
Track tokens, cost, active time and cache hit rate per agent, model, session and tool
Run Claude Code and Codex in terminal tabs that resume their session after an Obsidian restart
Resume a session in the other agent by copying the conversation into a new session file
disambiguation: It indexes AI coding agent session transcripts stored outside the vault, not the notes of your vault.
extras: macOS-only (12+), needs Obsidian desktop 1.8.7+ and python3 3.8+ with SQLite FTS5 trigram tokenizer; runs a local Python server on 127.0.0.1:8787. Optional AI features send session text through your own claude or codex CLI and are on by default; the README has extensive disclosures on network, clipboard, and file access outside the vault, plus a troubleshooting table.
problem: Obsidian gives no way to search, monitor, resume or measure the AI coding agent sessions a developer runs throughout the day, since those transcripts live outside the vault.

relations.evidence: It indexes the session transcripts of both agents (~/.claude/projects and Codex's ~/.codex/sessions) into one searchable catalog
Search, Active, Statistics, terminal tabs, Copy session and deletion work for Codex sessions too.

requires.name: Anthropic or OpenAI login (via the agent CLIs) for AI features and usage limits

summary: Indexes Claude Code and Codex session transcripts into a searchable catalog with live session cards, usage statistics, and resumable agent terminal tabs.
